title: My Brother Forged A Deed, Stole My $350K Farmhouse, And Evicted Me. So I Became His Landlord
description: My brother forged a deed to steal my $350,000 farmhouse and had me evicted on my 60th birthday. But I took him to court, won back the property and back rent. Now he pays me a rising triple-net lease while I run a farm-to-table B&B called The Forged Acre. #FamilyBetrayal #Revenge #Karma
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY FARM, NOW HE PAYS ME RENT
pinned_comment: If your own brother forged a deed to steal your $350K inheritance and had you evicted on your 60th birthday, what would you have done? Share your story below.
